explanation.headline: FDA's records show phenylephrine hydrochloride is not on the shortage list as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include phenylephrine hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East has 64 vials on hand at 5.9 vials per day, providing 10.8 days of supply.
Corvale General has 125 vials on hand at the same daily use, providing 21.3 days of supply.
Alternative manufacturers include Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC (plant last inspected VAI 2024-09-11) and Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. (plant last inspected VAI 2023-11-10).
No public FDA shortage signal exists for this product at our plants.

rejected.text: The top-ranked purchasing option is Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is also not on FDA's shortage list today and is supplied from Caplin Steriles Limited, last inspected NAI on 2024-08-09.
rejected.reason: Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC is not in the cited evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
